areaGuide.title: Living in TTDI – Complete Guide to Room Rental in Taman Tun Dr Ismail Kuala Lumpur
areaGuide.description: TTDI (Taman Tun Dr Ismail) is one of Kuala Lumpur's most established and desirable residential neighbourhoods for room rental. The area attracts professionals, expatriates, families, entrepreneurs, students and remote workers looking for comfortable living with excellent lifestyle facilities. Whether you are searching for a master room for rent in TTDI, a single room near TTDI MRT Station, a fully furnished room near 1 Utama, a condo room close to office districts or a premium apartment rental in Kuala Lumpur, TTDI offers a wide range of accommodation choices. Residents enjoy excellent MRT connectivity, popular cafes, restaurants, parks, shopping malls, healthcare facilities and easy access to Petaling Jaya, Mont Kiara, Bangsar and Kuala Lumpur city centre, making TTDI one of the most attractive places to rent a room in Klang Valley.
